baslik: Momo the Bear Knocks Over Ziggy's Tower
aciklama: Momo bumps into Ziggy's tall block tower by accident and learns how a kind sorry and a helping hand make things right.

satirlar.metin: Ziggy built the tallest block tower in the whole cozy room.
Look, Momo! It almost touches the ceiling!
Momo leaned closer to look, and... bump! The tower tumbled down.
Oh no! My tower! It took me all morning!
I didn't mean to, but I still feel very sorry.
Momo went outside and told Luna what had happened.
Hoo. When we make a mistake, saying sorry can mend a heart.
Then I will say sorry, and help build it again!
I'm sorry, Ziggy. Can we build an even taller tower together?
Yes! Two builders are better than one!
A kind sorry and a helping hand can make friends smile again.
